text.en:
1. This Order may be cited as the Casino Control (Exemption from Exclusion from Casino, etc.) Order 2013 and shall come into operation on 13th February 2013.
[S 640/2026 wef 21/09/2026]

heading.en: Exemption of person on legal aid who is not citizen or permanent resident

text.en:
2. Section 165A(3) of the Act does not apply to a person mentioned in section 165A(1)(a) of the Act who —
(a)is on the legal aid scheme under the International Child Abduction Act 2010; and
(b)is not a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore.
[S 640/2026 wef 21/09/2026]
